figures.caption: Figure 2. Overview of the proposed unified framework. Ten per-skill policies (one for grasp, one for relocate, six for rotation (x+/x-/y+/y/z+/z- of the hand frame), and two for translation (z+/z- of the hand frame)) are first trained independently and then distilled into a single unified policy via DAgger. All policies share a unified observation space, network architecture, and action space, and the per-skill policies share a unified reward formulation.
